name: Hajimete no Okaa-san
original_name: はじめてのおかあさん
source:
"Hey, Papa...let's make a baby..."

One year after the death of his wife, a sudden temptation. 
Unable to endure that sweet voice, the protagonist lays his hands on his daughter. Despite his guilt over not being able to hold back, those acts persisted. Before long, his daughter is pregnant... 

[translated from [url=http://www.nanika-modoki.com/doujin/12/index.html]official page[/url]]
translation:
“嘿，爸爸……我们来造个孩子吧……”妻子去世一年后，一个突如其来的诱惑。无法忍受那甜美的声音，主人公将手伸向了自己的女儿。尽管对自己的无法克制感到愧疚，但这些行为仍在持续。不久后，女儿怀孕了……

[译自[url=http://www.nanika-modoki.com/doujin/12/index.html]官方页面[/url]]
